invariants.name: assert_idempotency_unique
invariants.sql:
SELECT 'memory'::text AS tbl, count(*)::int AS c FROM memory_items WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND idempotency_key LIKE $2
          UNION ALL
          SELECT 'tasks', count(*)::int FROM tasks WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND created_at >= $3
          UNION ALL
          SELECT 'reminders', count(*)::int FROM reminders WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND created_at >= $3
          UNION ALL
          SELECT 'outbound', count(*)::int FROM messages WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND direction='outbound' AND created_at >= $3

invariants.name: assert_one_outbound_for_case
invariants.sql:
SELECT count(*)::int AS c FROM outbound_delivery_ledger_claude_mcp
          WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND idempotency_key = $2
